title: UI kit: one small set of parts every page uses

chat.text: Pages and cards are built from one small kit (headings, text, card, row, item, tree, controls), browsed as a tree in the library, and a merge check catches broken layout without screenshots. Plan first at /live/plan/ui-kit/, then the smallest working version.

message.text: Plan at /live/plan/ui-kit/, reviewed and reordered: first a merge check that measures every changed page (no screenshots), then five card styles in the library with arrow keys. The merge check is being built now.
